groups.context_text: Om Ooh Hello Done, frio Today They are celebrating Bhagwan Mahavir's Janmotsav Today is a day of expressing heartfelt gratitude. Let us close our eyes for two minutes. Let us bow down our head in Paramatma's feet and feel thankful to Prabhu from the bottom of our heart.

Hey Prabhu If you had not grasped this land If you had not taught us the values of Ahimsa, Truth non-stealing, celibacy, non-possessionness. Then Even we would be doing so many wrong activities like the other living beings on this planet. even they would have been involved in violence lies stealing possessions We would also be polluting our soul with these bad qualities. Hey Prabhu With a vow in our hearts to bow down to you. and express our heartfelt Vandana Prabhu, it is your infinite grace on each and every one of us. Prabhu, you practiced tough Sadhana for twelve and a half long years.

You tolerated so much pain and so many difficulties. But when you achieved Kevalnan, as a result of that Sadhana, you did not limit that knowledge only to yourself. You did not stay selfish in what you achieved. But you utilized it for the well-being of the entire world. You gave knowledge to the entire world. Prabhu, we express our deep gratitude to you for the complete knowledge that you gave us in the form of Agamas. If you had not given us that knowledge, even we would be committing so many sins today. We would be giving pain to so many living beings.

We would also be killing so many animals and birds for our test. And we would be enjoying such harmful and cruel acts. Prabhu, it is you who has saved us from so many sins. It is your Maha Upkar. You not only taught us the quality of Ahimsa, but you nurtured that quality in our soul, in our deep memories. And so, we have been saved from countless wrong activities today. Prabhu We are very fortunate to have you.

We are very fortunate to have you. And so, we celebrate today's day with immense enthusiasm and gratitude in our hearts. Hey Prabhu, navigate our religion and your path of truth and compassion in every birth. Hey Prabhu, May we attain your sharan in every birth. Okay Open your eyes Open your eyes Done, Priyo. Today, as we celebrate the occasion of Bhagwan Mahavir Janmotsav. I want to tell you something. We all worship Prabhu Mahavir but this Parishad Mahaprabhu has come to give us a different message.
